title: Pure Venom
summary: The Reptile Venom deck with its generic Reptile support and staples. The page covers two decks that share a name: this list is the Reptile one, built around Venom Counters and Vennominaga. The Starving Venom Dragons, including the newest card, Starving Venom Wing Dragon, need Predaplant and Clear Wing cards and are on the Predaplant page's list; the page itself warns against mixing the two. Venom Swamp shrinks every non-Venom monster in the End Phase, and the small snakes add more counters. Snake Rain and Venom Shot fill the GY with Reptiles so Vennominon grows. When Vennominon is destroyed by a card effect, Rise of the Snake Deity calls Vennominaga, which is unaffected by Spells, Traps and other monster effects and wins after three hits.
main: Vennominon the King of Poisonous Snakes
Gains 500 ATK per Reptile in your GY and revives itself after battle.
Vennominaga the Deity of Poisonous Snakes
Win condition: unaffected by other cards, wins after three hits.
Venom Serpent
Places a Venom Counter every turn and still attacks.
Venom Snake
Places a Venom Counter every turn.
Venom Boa
Places two Venom Counters every turn.
Venom Cobra
Normal Reptile: Level 4 body for Snake Whistle and Rank 4s.
Venom Swamp
Field Spell: every End Phase, a counter on each non-Venom monster, -500 ATK each.
Venom Shot
Mills a Reptile and places two counters.
Snake Rain
Generic Reptile mill: sends four Reptiles to the GY.
Rise of the Snake Deity
Summons Vennominaga from the hand or Deck when Vennominon is destroyed by an effect.
Snake Whistle
Generic Reptile trap: summons a Level 4 or lower Reptile when one is destroyed.
Snake Deity's Command
Counter Trap: reveals a Venom to negate a Spell.
Ambush Fangs
Stops an attack on a Venom and ends the Battle Phase.
Venom Burn
Cashes in a monster's counters for 700 damage each.
